title: Client and version compatibility fields with minimum-client negotiation
question_or_target: Add `min_client_version` / `supported_clients` to the manifest and implement the negotiation that refuses installation on an unsupported client with a message naming the exact required version, instead of installing and failing later at hook-load time.
answer: tools/plugin/client_negotiate.py is the install-time gate. .claude-plugin/plugin.json now carries min_client_version=1.0.0 and supported_clients=['claude-code', 'codex']. Unparsable versions fail closed. Refusal messages name the exact required version. Destination payload is not written on refuse. Live `claude --version` / `codex --version` were invoked and fed through the same negotiate() as the fixtures. SUCCESS:IMP-0008
mechanism: semver compare at install preflight; fail-closed parse; message names min_client_version

evidence.claim: negotiate() refuses a synthetic below-floor client version and the refusal message names the exact required version; preflight_install writes no destination payload.

negative_controls.description: fail_open_unparsable treats unparsable versions as allowed. Production negotiate() refuses them and names min_client_version.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 runs Codex CLI (`codex --version`) as a second runtime and checks the abstraction does not leak: Codex-shaped version strings parse without the word 'claude'.
